knowledge_gaps: Training-prefix targets were already available during fitting. Their perturbation responses may reflect memorization and need not explain validation errors; bootstrap intervals do not remove this bias.

Deletion and left-padding can change sequence length, positional offsets and temporal relationships simultaneously. The protocol needs explicit handling of HSTU positional/time features, maximum-length truncation and empty histories.

Reproduction requires fixed user/prefix counts, deletion sizes, sampling rules, history-length strata, tie handling, bootstrap settings and a diagnostic compute limit. Category-level aggregation also needs coordination across the four separate ModelView instances.
Top-10 overlap among 100 sampled candidates does not measure full-catalog recommendation stability. The required full-catalog recommendations for twenty training users remain a separate obligation.

Originality 5/10 is reasonable, but potential 8/10 is speculative without evidence connecting diagnostic findings to validation improvements. Difficulty 3/10 understates temporal controls and aggregation. A minimal discrimination and availability audit should accompany the temporal probe.
